decision_authority: User-requested correction on 2026-09-18 after exact Production read-back. The approved original Human Authoring request already defines Spartacus's 73-71 BCE rebellion as Roman Republic + opposes; current Production has drifted to polity=null/relation=null with a note that incorrectly treats opponent context as a reason to omit the polity. Restore the canonical reviewed semantics while preserving Activity identity, chronology, role, period basis, confidence, and all normalized source links.

evidence.rationale: Spartacus's modeled Activity is the Third Servile War against the Roman Republic. ATLAS relation semantics represent an opponent polity with opposes; polity=null loses a known political relationship and prevents canonical spatial placement. This does not imply allegiance, service, or membership in the Roman Republic.
evidence.execution_retry: Retry after PR #1125 fixed correction-v2 exact-before handling for legacy polity=null and added opposition-only spacetime counterparty-context placement.

after.reviewed_notes: Spartacus led the major slave revolt against the Roman Republic traditionally called the Third Servile War from 73 to 71 BCE. ATLAS binds this Activity to the Roman Republic with relation opposes because the polity is the historically explicit opponent of the rebellion; this binding does not imply allegiance, service, or membership.
